# mycelium

> A live, read-only map of Joel's mycelium as it stands: the machines at
> the root, each orchestration's hub on a cord from them, and every
> session as a cell round its hub, redrawn as the node says it changes.

- [The page](index.html): the map, walked by keyboard or pointer, with
  each thing's details and the whole network as a tree beside it.
- [The page as text](index.md): how to read the map, its keys, and what
  the data holds.
- The data: the machine's mycelium node, watched live through the sites'
  server from core.nix's local-sites module; `mycelium networks -o json`
  prints the same records in a terminal.
- [All his sites](../llms.txt): the home this page sits in.
